indication_area: Hemophilia A and B with inhibitors
formulation: lyophilized powder for solution for intravenous injection
moa: plasma-derived activated prothrombin complex (inhibitor bypassing agent)

approval_evidence.quote: Initial U.S. Approval: 1986 (FEIBA package insert, FDA CBER product page https://www.fda.gov/vaccines-blood-biologics/approved-blood-products/feiba, BL 101447)

series_start_reason: Series starts 2018Q2 (Takeda fiscal Q1 FY2018). Takeda's FY2019 Q1 data book (qr2019_q1_d_en_revised.pdf) prints FEIBA for fiscal Q1-Q4 FY2018 in a pro forma column of legacy Shire's product sales (April 2018-March 2019, US GAAP, excluding the divested oncology business, converted to JPY at the FY2018 actual rate, as if the acquisition had occurred on April 1, 2018); the fiscal Q4 FY2018 pro forma figure equals the existing first row, taken from Takeda's FY2018 Q4 statements (Shire 3-month column). Before April 2018 the line is not printed by anyone: Shire's results releases, 10-Qs and 10-K print hematology franchise totals only, and Baxalta's releases print only 'Hemophilia' and 'Inhibitor Therapies' (see search_log).
notes: From the FY2023 reports Takeda re-grouped plasma-derived products (FEIBA, CINRYZE, immunoglobulin, albumin) under a 'PDT' heading; the FEIBA row and its definition are unchanged and its quarterly values continue the FY2019-FY2022 line (FY2022 Q4 doc prints FEIBA 8.7 for Jan-Mar 2023 in the Rare Hematology table; FY2023 docs show the same prior-year values). Printed label is 'FEIBA' with a PDT footnote marker. launch_quarter null: FEIBA was licensed in the US in 1986, long before any series quarter. 2018Q2-2018Q4 (and for Cinryze and Firazyr only 2018Q4) are Takeda's FY2018 pro forma columns in the FY2019 Q1 data book (qr2019_q1_d_en_revised.pdf): legacy Shire's product sales for April 2018-March 2019, US GAAP, excluding the oncology business divested in August 2018, converted to JPY at the FY2018 actual rate, as if the acquisition had occurred on April 1, 2018. Takeda warns that pro forma figures may not represent what sales would have been; the fiscal Q4 FY2018 pro forma figure equals the figure Takeda reports in its own FY2018 Q4 statements for the Shire three-month column, which is the existing first row of the series.
search_log: reused the Takeda quarterly-results PDF set already downloaded for the sibling batch (takeda.com assets-dam files for FY2018 Q4 through FY2026 Q1: financial statements, data books FY2019, quarterly financial reports FY2020 on) and re-extracted text with pdfplumber (the verifier's extractor); every cited URL is the takeda.com copy of the document

for each Takeda fiscal quarter the product-sales analysis page was read: FY2018 Q4 financial statements (Shire 3 months), FY2019 data books (quarterly trend table), FY2020 onward quarterly financial reports (three-month FY(n-1) vs FY(n) table)
EDGAR (Takeda CIK 0001395064) 6-K earnings exhibits were not individually resolved; the takeda.com copies of the same quarterly documents were cited instead
cross-check: for each fiscal year the four quarterly values were summed against the full-year product figure printed in the Q4 document (differences at most 0.2 billion JPY from rounding)

Baxalta 10-K FY2015 (0001193125-16-491806), 10-Qs and Q2 2015-Q1 2016 earnings exhibits searched for FEIBA: sales appear only inside the 'Inhibitor Therapies' category (FEIBA plus OBIZUR), not as a product line; Shire 8-K earnings exhibits and 10-K/10-Q 2016-2018 print no FEIBA sales line

Reopened to extend the start. Takeda's FY2019 Q1 data book (qr2019_q1_d_en_revised.pdf, section 3 'Product Sales Analysis (vs FY2018 Pro-forma)', section 4 'FY2018 Pro-forma and Product Forecasts') prints FEIBA for FY18 Q1-Q4 pro forma; fiscal Q1-Q3 FY2018 give 2018Q2-2018Q4.

Shire plc (CIK 936402): every item 2.02 8-K exhibit 99 of 2008-2018, the Forms 10-Q and 10-K 2014-2018 and the results presentations of Q1 2016 to Q3 2018 were scanned for ADYNOVATE and FEIBA rows; none prints a sales figure for either product (the Q4 2017 presentation shows 2017 FEIBA at about $0.8 billion and ADVATE/ADYNOVATE combined at about $2.4 billion, annual and rounded to a tenth of a billion, which is not a quarterly series).

Baxalta (CIK 1620546): the five earnings 8-Ks of 2015-07-30 to 2016-04-28, with their exhibits 99.1 and 99.2, print the Hematology franchise as 'Hemophilia' and 'Inhibitor Therapies' (the latter contains FEIBA and OBIZUR) and mention ADYNOVATE only as a launch; no ADYNOVATE or FEIBA sales row exists.
Shire filed nothing for the fourth quarter of 2018 (no 2018 Form 10-K; Form 15 on 2019-02-07); the fiscal Q3 FY2018 pro forma figure is the only printed October-December 2018 figure.
